notes.title: Hiding app from future sale
notes.content:
Hi, it's Nick the solo dev on this.
I've decided to put this part of my life on hold while I explore other options.
I am sorry for any inconvenience this may cause.
Best wishes,
Nick

notes.title: Version 2019.x.x -> 2020.x.x
notes.content:
Please let me know if you have any feedback or issues with the 2020.x.x version
here [url=http://AVOlight.com]AVOlight.com[/url]

if you would like to stay on the 2019.x.x version

right click the app in steam
click properties in the context menu
click the beta tab
and select 2019 from the drop down menu
